newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Spring mixed, white down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Spring mixed, white down.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids were mixed while white wheat values slipped.

Movement was slow as farmers opt to wait for higher prices. "If we could get up to $4.30-$4.40 a bushel, basis nearby Minneapolis wheat futures, then farmers might start to sell," a Minneapolis dealer said.
MGE December wheat was off 1-1/4 cents to end at $4.09 a bushel while the rest of board was two to six cents higher.
One Montana dealer said producers were targeting $4.50 for spring wheat as well as winter wheat.
"Farmers are waiting for better prices," he said.
Farmer selling was also sluggish in the Pacific Northwest, an Oregon dealer said, noting a lack of export business.
